output.title: Answering "What is the MOOP on this Medicare Advantage plan?"
output.draft_text:
Question: What is the maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) amount on this Medicare Advantage (MA) plan?

Advocate answer: "The maximum out-of-pocket amount, or MOOP, is the most you would pay in a plan year for [types of covered services counted toward the MOOP] before the plan pays 100% of covered costs for the rest of that year. Based on the plan records I can see today, the MOOP on your plan is [in-network MOOP amount] for in-network services [and [combined in-network and out-of-network MOOP amount] for in-network and out-of-network services combined, if applicable to the plan type]. So far this plan year, you have paid [amount applied toward MOOP to date] toward that amount."

What counts toward the MOOP: [list of cost types that count toward the MOOP, for example deductibles, copays, coinsurance for covered services].

What does not count toward the MOOP: [list of cost types that do not count toward the MOOP, including how Part D prescription drug costs are treated].

Prescription drug questions: If the member asks whether their prescription costs count toward the MOOP, say: "[approved explanation of how prescription drug costs relate to the MOOP and any separate drug out-of-pocket limit]." For drug pricing questions, use the approved price estimate disclaimer.

Where to find it: Advocates can find the MOOP in [system or screen name where the MOOP and year-to-date amount are shown].

If the MOOP is not shown or the member disputes the amount: [approved escalation or referral steps, for example transfer queue or document to reference].

Reset: The MOOP applies per [plan year or calendar year period] and resets on [reset date].
placeholders: [types of covered services counted toward the MOOP]
[list of cost types that count toward the MOOP, for example deductibles, copays, coinsurance for covered services]
[list of cost types that do not count toward the MOOP, including how Part D prescription drug costs are treated]
[approved explanation of how prescription drug costs relate to the MOOP and any separate drug out-of-pocket limit]
[system or screen name where the MOOP and year-to-date amount are shown]
[approved escalation or referral steps, for example transfer queue or document to reference]
author_checklist: Confirm whether the MOOP amount should be quoted from the member's plan record or whether advocates should be directed to a specific source document (e.g., Evidence of Coverage or Summary of Benefits).
Confirm which plan types have only an in-network MOOP versus a combined in-network and out-of-network MOOP, and remove the combined sentence where not applicable.
Confirm exactly which cost types count and do not count toward the MOOP.
Confirm with Benefits and Pharmacy how Part D prescription drug costs relate to the MA MOOP and whether a separate drug out-of-pocket limit should be explained; obtain approved wording.
Confirm whether advocates can see and quote the member's year-to-date amount applied toward the MOOP, and in which system/screen.
Confirm whether a disclaimer is required when quoting MOOP or year-to-date amounts; have Legal review (nearby units U-RX-EDU-001-09 and U-RX-EDU-002-07 cover drug price estimates only).
Confirm the MOOP reset period and date.
Confirm the escalation path when the MOOP is not displayed or the member disputes it.
Confirm whether one unit should serve both Pharmacy and Insurance advocates or whether a pharmacy-specific variant is needed, and confirm the correct knowledge base.
Note that nearby units U-RX-EDU-001-09 and U-RX-EDU-002-07 appear to be near-duplicates; flag for consolidation if appropriate.
